opportunities.title: AI Chatbot & Automation Developer – Facebook, TikTok, n8n, Google Forms
opportunities.description: ## Project Overview Kaelor Technologies is looking for an experienced AI Chatbot and Workflow Automation Developer for a potential client project in Japan. The client operates or may operate online retail and recruitment-related services. We need a developer capable of designing and implementing an integrated automation system for Facebook Messenger, TikTok, Google Forms, Google Sheets, and business operations. The final scope is subject to client confirmation. We are initially hiring for technical feasibility assessment and a potential MVP implementation, with opportunities for further development. ## 1. Facebook & TikTok Automation - Automatically respond to incoming customer messages. - Handle frequently asked questions and product inquiries. - Collect customer information, order requests, and booking inquiries. - Route complex conversations to human administrators. - Support multilingual communication (Burmese, Japanese, and English). - Assess TikTok Business Messaging API eligibility and integration feasibility. - Use official APIs and platform-compliant integration methods. ## 2. AI Chatbot Development - Evaluate rule-based, AI-powered, and hybrid chatbot approaches. - Integrate OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, or suitable AI services if needed. - Configure knowledge-based responses using approved business information. - Prevent unsupported claims about products, prices, job availability, or application outcomes. - Implement conversation logging, error handling, and human handoff. ## 3. Google Forms & Recruitment Automation - Recreate or improve an existing multilingual Google Form. - Collect job applicant registration information. - Integrate Google Forms with Google Sheets. - Automate application notifications and administrative workflows. - Support basic applicant tracking and status management. - Implement appropriate personal-data security and access controls. ## 4. Online Retail Workflow - Handle product inquiries and customer requests. - Collect order details and customer contact information. - Store and organize order requests. - Notify administrators about new customer inquiries. - Support future integrations with inventory, payment, or order management systems. ## 5. Preferred Technologies - n8n / Make / Zapier - Facebook Messenger API / Meta Webhooks - TikTok Business Messaging API or approved integrations - OpenAI API / Gemini API / Claude API - Google Forms / Google Sheets / Apps Script - Node.js / TypeScript / Python - REST APIs, webhooks, and database integrations We are open to alternative technologies if they are more cost-effective, secure, and maintainable. ## 6. Expected Deliverables - Technical feasibility assessment and architecture proposal - Clear implementation plan with milestones - Working Facebook chatbot MVP - Google Forms and Google Sheets integration - Automation workflows and configuration - Testing and demonstration - Source code / workflow exports - Deployment and handover documentation - Separate TikTok integration estimate after feasibility verification ## 7. Budget & Timeline **Initial MVP Budget: $250–$450 USD** This budget is intended for a limited, clearly defined first implementation, not the complete advanced multi-platform system. Please provide separate quotations for: 1. Technical feasibility assessment 2. Facebook Messenger + Google Forms MVP 3. AI chatbot functionality 4. TikTok integration 5. Additional recruitment and online retail automation 6. Monthly maintenance and third-party services The timeline is negotiable based on the proposed technical approach. ## 8. Application Requirements Please answer the following questions: 1. Have you built and deployed a Facebook Messenger chatbot using official Meta APIs? Provide examples. 2. Have you integrated TikTok Business Messaging? Which API or approved provider did you use? 3. What restrictions or permissions could prevent TikTok integration for a Japan-based business? 4. Have you developed automation using n8n and Google Sheets? 5. Can you build separate workflows for online retail and recruitment? 6. What architecture would you recommend for this project? 7. What can you realistically deliver within $250–$450? 8. What are your estimated timeline and additional operating costs? 9. Can you provide full source code, workflows, documentation, and deployment assistance? Please include relevant portfolio links or demonstrations. We prefer developers with proven production experience rather than generic AI-generated proposals. ## About Kaelor Technologies Kaelor Technologies provides custom software development, AI integration, and business workflow automation solutions. We are interested in establishing long-term relationships with reliable developers for future client projects.

opportunities.title: Browser Retro Pseudo-3D Game Engine
opportunities.description: I’m building a fully browser-based, Wolfenstein-style game maker and need a developer to craft the core engine and its accompanying website. Core functionality • Engine runs entirely client-side—no desktop installers, no server-side rendering. Open the URL and create. • The editor must let users place and tweak maps, enemies, items, doors, weapons, and even set up simple missions. • Level building should feel flexible: creators can draw on a top-down grid but may also pull in ready-made room templates, then modify as they wish. • Finished projects publish with a single click, producing a shareable web link that anyone can load instantly in their browser. No downloads required. Platform extras • A visible counter on the homepage keeps track of how many games have been created with the engine and updates live. • Every exported game shows a brief loading screen that features the engine’s logo before the gameplay begins; the logo file should be easy for me to swap later. Acceptable deliverable A working web application (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/WebGL or similar) packaged for simple deployment on standard hosting. The build should load quickly, support modern Chromium and Firefox browsers, and include clear developer notes so I can extend art assets and missions over time. If you have experience with retro rendering techniques, ECS pattern, or WebGL texture management, that will definitely help us move fast.

opportunities.title: Photorealistic WooCommerce 3D Blade Configurator
opportunities.description: I’m looking for an experienced developer to create an interactive 3D product configurator for my table tennis blades, inspired by the Nike By You customization experience. Customers should be able to customize different product components, materials, colors and designs, with a real-time 3D preview, dynamic pricing and estimated weight. Photorealistic quality is extremely important. The 3D models must accurately reproduce the real products, including realistic wood grain, textures, finishes, lighting and fine details. The visual quality should be as close as possible to professional product photography. Ideally, the same 3D models should also allow us to generate high-resolution, photorealistic product images from different angles for our website, catalog and advertising campaigns. The configurator must be fully integrated with our existing WordPress/WooCommerce online shop, including cart and checkout. I already have all product CAD models created in Autodesk Fusion 360. Please include in your proposal: - Examples of similar 3D configurators you have developed, preferably with photorealistic rendering. - The technology you recommend. - How we would independently add new products, materials and customization options. - How you would achieve photorealistic quality, both in the interactive 3D viewer and in high-resolution product renders. - Estimated budget and development time. - Any ongoing licensing or subscription costs. Further project details and product examples will be shared with selected candidates. IMPORTANT – PLEASE READ BEFORE BIDDING ONLY PROPOSALS INCLUDING A DIRECT LINK TO A LIVE, WORKING 3D PRODUCT CONFIGURATOR YOU HAVE PERSONALLY DEVELOPED WILL BE CONSIDERED. NO LINK = NO CONSIDERATION. Generic portfolios, screenshots and AI-generated proposals without verifiable examples will be ignored.

opportunities.title: Reusable n8n CSV to MySQL
opportunities.description: I’m building an automated import flow in n8n and need a reusable workflow that starts from a simple web form where I can upload a CSV. After the file is received, the workflow should parse every row, let me pick which CSV columns map to which MySQL fields through an easy-to-reach settings step (no code edits), and then push the data into the target table. Key behaviour I expect: • If a row is missing required data or contains an invalid value, the workflow should quietly skip that row, continue processing the rest, and keep a clear error log I can download at the end. • All other valid rows go straight into MySQL in a single run. The finished workflow must be easy to clone to new n8n instances and quick to adjust whenever the underlying table or the incoming CSV format changes. Please include brief setup notes so I can drop in my database credentials, point the web-form node to my site, and get rolling without touching the internal logic.

opportunities.title: SaaS QA Testers Needed
opportunities.description: We are looking for detail-oriented QA Test Engineers (Junior & Senior) to thoroughly test a modern SaaS web application before its public launch We are planning to hire 2–4 QA testers for an initial testing phase with the possibility of ongoing work across multiple projects Our goal is to identify bugs, broken workflows, UI/UX inconsistencies, performance issues, and unexpected behaviors before releasing the application to production Scope of Work You will be responsible for testing the application from a real user's perspective while also exploring edge cases and unexpected scenarios Key responsibilities Perform comprehensive manual testing across the application Test complete end-to-end user journeys Validate authentication, registration, login, and account management flows Test forms, validation rules, error handling, and user permissions Identify functional bugs, broken workflows, and unexpected behavior Perform edge-case testing, including duplicate submissions, rapid interactions, invalid inputs, and interrupted requests Test responsive layouts across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices Identify UI/UX inconsistencies, alignment issues, and usability problems Test application behavior under slow or unstable network conditions Identify potential performance bottlenecks and slow-loading pages Verify fixes and perform regression testing when needed Required Deliverables 1. Structured Bug Report All identified issues must be documented in a centralized Google Sheet or similar tracking system Each issue must include Unique Bug ID Clear issue title and description Severity level (Critical, High, Medium, Low) Exact steps to reproduce Expected behavior vs actual behavior Browser, operating system, and device information Screenshots or screen recordings Relevant console errors or network logs when available 2. Video Evidence Provide screen recordings demonstrating identified bugs whenever possible Videos should clearly show the steps leading to the issue and the resulting unexpected behavior 3. Testing Summary Provide a final testing summary covering Features and modules tested Total bugs identified by severity Areas successfully tested Areas requiring additional attention Any blockers or limitations encountered Overall assessment of release readiness 4. Time Tracking Maintain a clear record of active testing hours and provide a breakdown of time spent on testing, documentation, and bug verification Requirements Previous experience testing SaaS platforms or complex web applications Strong understanding of manual QA methodologies Experience with functional, regression, exploratory, and edge-case testing Ability to write clear and reproducible bug reports Familiarity with browser developer tools (Console and Network) Experience testing responsive web applications Strong attention to detail Good written English communication skills Ability to work independently and meet deadlines Nice to Have Experience testing CRM, messaging, automation, or business management platforms Familiarity with REST APIs and Postman Basic understanding of JavaScript and web application architecture Experience with Playwright, Cypress, or other automated testing tools Experience with performance testing tools Project Details Project Type: SaaS Web Application Testing Type: Manual QA, Functional Testing, Edge Cases, UI/UX, Regression Initial Engagement: Paid trial testing assignment (8–10 hours) Potential: Long-term collaboration based on performance Experience Level: Junior and Senior QA Engineers are welcome Start Date: As soon as possible How to Apply Please include the following in your proposal A brief introduction and your QA testing experience Examples of previous bug reports or testing documentation The desktop and mobile devices and browsers available for testing Your experience testing SaaS applications Your availability and estimated turnaround time Your fixed price for an initial 8–10 hour testing assignment Any tools you typically use for testing and bug tracking Important We are looking for testers who actively investigate unexpected behaviors rather than simply following basic checklists We value detailed documentation, reproducible bug reports, clear communication, and the ability to discover issues that typical users might encounter To confirm that you have read the full description, please start your proposal with Project ID: QA-2026 Applications without this identifier may not be considered

opportunities.title: Complex WordPress/WooCommerce Debug & Fix
opportunities.description: Our long-running WooCommerce store has drifted into a tangle of problems—pages built with Elementor sometimes render half-broken, orders randomly fail, the database occasionally spikes to 100 % CPU, and server logs show intermittent 500 errors that no one has traced to a single culprit. A few quick patches have masked the symptoms for a day or two, but the instability always creeps back. I need you to run a full-scale technical audit, uncover the root causes, and engineer permanent fixes. That means digging through code, plugins, theme overrides, queries, and server configurations until the chain of issues is truly resolved. I can give you admin credentials, cPanel/SSH, and error logs; if you need staging cloned from production, just outline the setup and I’ll arrange it. The remit includes: • A written report that pinpoints each underlying issue (WooCommerce hooks, Elementor conflicts, misconfigured caching, database bottlenecks, PHP/NGINX settings—whatever you find). • Clean, well-documented code or configuration changes applied first on staging, then promoted to live after approval. • Post-fix verification: cross-browser/device testing, load testing where relevant, and confirmation that checkout, account pages, and Elementor templates work flawlessly. • A brief hand-off outlining any ongoing maintenance or monitoring we should keep in place. Advanced debugging tools such as Query Monitor, WP-CLI, xDebug, or New Relic are welcome—use whatever will get to the truth fastest. If a custom plugin tweak, database index, or server cache rule is required, that’s within scope. I’m looking for someone who has solved gnarly WordPress performance and stability puzzles before, not just installed plugins. Let me know your approach and typical turnaround for an audit of this depth, and we can get started right away.

opportunities.title: Office Fit-Out Electrical & Lighting
opportunities.description: I’m planning a complete electrical and lighting package for a brand-new office fit-out and need a designer who can translate my floor plan into clear, code-compliant documentation. The priority is a bright, practical atmosphere that helps staff stay focused, so task-oriented light levels, glare control and efficient fixture placement are critical. You’ll receive the architectural layout (DWG/PDF) and basic workstation counts. From there, I need: • Lighting layout with fixture specification, lux calculations and switching zones optimised for productivity • Power and small-power layouts covering workstations, printers, AV points and any future expansion bays • Circuiting, board schedules and single-line diagram showing load balance and protection devices • Basic cable sizing, conduit routes and legend sheets ready for the electrician’s take-off • A short specification listing fittings, control gear, and energy-efficiency notes aligned to local codes Deliverables should be in native AutoCAD (or Revit if preferred) plus a plotted PDF set. I’ll review drafts, mark up comments, and sign off once lux calculations and board schedules meet the brief. If you have recent office projects in your portfolio—particularly where clear illuminance targets and neat power distribution were achieved—please share them along with your proposed turnaround time.

opportunities.title: Modern Services Booking Website Build
opportunities.description: I need a polished, fully responsive website that lets visitors purchase my services online and lock in their preferred date and time right on the site. The entire journey—from landing on the home page to confirming a booking—should feel effortless, fast and visually engaging on desktop, tablet and mobile. Design & Frontend The interface must look fresh and contemporary, with clear typography, ample white space and a colour palette that reflects a professional brand. I prefer the site to be built with React, supported by clean HTML5, CSS3 (or a modern pre-processor), and vanilla or modular JavaScript for any interactive elements. Smooth page transitions, animated feedback on buttons and well-structured forms are important so users always know what step they’re on. Core Functionality • Service catalogue with individual pages that outline each offering. • Booking flow where customers pick a specific date and time before checkout. • Real-time form validation and helpful error messages. • Lightweight SEO best practices baked in (semantic tags, meta data, fast load times). Performance & Code Quality Please keep bundle sizes lean, optimise images and minimise render-blocking assets so pages load quickly. The codebase must be easy to maintain, clearly commented and organised by reusable components. Testing & Deployment I expect cross-device testing (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge; major iOS and Android resolutions) before we move to production. Once approved, you’ll deploy to my preferred host (Netlify, Vercel or similar) and confirm that SSL, redirects and analytics are functioning. What to send back • Links to two or three React projects that show elegant UI and booking, form or e-commerce features. • Your estimated timeline from kickoff to launch. • A simple price breakdown or milestone plan. If this aligns with your skill set, I’m ready to get started right away.

opportunities.title: AI SEO & B2B Lead Generation
opportunities.description: I want to combine today’s best AI-powered SEO practices with precision-targeted email marketing so my site consistently brings in qualified enquiries from businesses that need ongoing services—not casual browsers or one-off buyers. Scope of work • Use AI tools (ChatGPT, SurferSEO, SEMrush, Ahrefs—or your own proven stack) to audit the current site, surface the keywords and content gaps that decision-makers search when they are actively evaluating long-term providers, then implement the on-page and technical fixes that push those pages toward the top positions. • Build a segmented list of relevant companies, enrich the data, and craft an email sequence that speaks to their pain points and highlights our service continuity. Personalisation, deliverability optimisation, and A/B testing are expected parts of the workflow. • Set up tracking so we can see exactly which keyword + email touchpoint produced each enquiry. Deliverables 1. SEO audit report with prioritised action plan. 2. Optimised pages (copy, meta, schema) published and live. 3. End-to-end email campaign: list, copy, automation, and performance dashboard. 4. Monthly summary showing rankings, open/click rates, and—most importantly—the number of qualified leads generated. Success is defined by a clear uptick in businesses booking discovery calls or requesting retainers. If additional channels such as Google Search ads or LinkedIn outreach later prove useful, the strategy can flex, but initial focus stays on organic search plus email campaigns.

opportunities.title: EPLAN Pro Panel Design Engineer – UL-Compliant DC Fast EV Chargers for USA (120–400 kW)
opportunities.description: We are an EV DC fast charger manufacturer seeking an experienced EPLAN Pro Panel / Electrical Design Engineer with proven experience designing DC fast EV chargers for the US market, specifically for UL/ETL (NRTL) certification requirements. Our objective is to develop and optimize the complete electrical design, internal component layout, wiring and mechanical mounting arrangements of our 120–400 kW DC fast chargers to support successful UL/ETL certification in the United States. Scope of Work Electrical Design: Develop or revise electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, protection circuits and power distribution arrangements using EPLAN Electric P8. 3D Cabinet Design: Create or update detailed EPLAN Pro Panel 3D layouts showing exact component locations, dimensions and mounting arrangements. Power Components: Design placement and connections of MCCBs, contactors, DC fuses, busbars, power modules and protection devices. Control Components: Position controller PCBs, PLCs, communication modules, relays, power supplies and terminal blocks. Mechanical Layout: Optimize DIN rails, mounting plates, cable ducts, cooling systems, ventilation, cable routing and external connectors. UL Compliance: Review and optimize the design considering applicable US certification requirements, including UL 2202, UL 2231, UL 2251 and other applicable standards. Safety & Protection: Address electrical clearances, creepage distances, grounding/bonding, insulation, thermal management, component ratings and separation of AC/DC and control circuits. Manufacturing Documentation: Prepare detailed mounting drawings, drilling drawings, wiring schedules, terminal diagrams and BOM. Mandatory Experience Strong proficiency in EPLAN Electric P8 and EPLAN Pro Panel. Previous hands-on experience designing DC fast EV chargers for the US market. Practical involvement in UL/ETL certification projects for DC EV chargers, preferably UL 2202. Knowledge of US electrical safety requirements, UL-listed/recognized components, high-current DC systems and relevant NEC/NFPA requirements. Experience resolving design observations raised by UL, Intertek (ETL) or other NRTL certification bodies. Ability to work remotely using existing charger designs, photographs, component specifications and cabinet measurements. Resources Available We can provide existing electrical schematics, component lists, charger photographs, dimensional measurements and available CAD/EPLAN project files. Expected Deliverables Complete editable EPLAN Electric P8 and Pro Panel project files. Updated 3D cabinet assembly with accurate component placement. UL/ETL-oriented design review and compliance gap report. Detailed manufacturing and mounting drawings. Electrical wiring diagrams, terminal schedules and BOM. Recommendations for component changes required to support US certification. Acceptance Criteria The project will be considered complete when the agreed components are accurately represented, mechanical collision checks pass, the design matches verified cabinet dimensions, and all identified design issues affecting UL/ETL certification have been documented and addressed within the agreed scope. Final certification will remain subject to evaluation and testing by the applicable NRTL. Important – Before Applying Applicants must provide: Details of DC fast EV chargers previously designed, including power ratings. Specific experience with UL 2202 / ETL certification projects for the US market. Examples of previous EPLAN Pro Panel 3D cabinet designs. Details of any certification-related design modifications or NRTL observations successfully resolved. Estimated project cost and completion timeline. Preference will be given to engineers who have worked on DC fast chargers that successfully obtained UL/ETL certification in the United States. This assignment may lead to long-term engineering collaboration across our 120 kW, 240 kW, 300 kW, 360 kW and 400 kW charger models.

opportunities.title: Dynamic Landing Page for Marketing Agency
opportunities.description: I’m launching a new digital-marketing agency and need a single, conversion-focused landing page that will do three jobs at once: get visitors to book a consultation, request a quote, and subscribe for updates. The page has to speak directly to professional service firms and ambitious online stores, positioning our agency as the partner that can move their revenue needle. Core content The copy and visual flow should spotlight our key offers—Social media marketing, Search engine marketing, AI automation and SEO—showing real-world benefits rather than buzzwords. I have brand colours and a logo ready; the rest of the creative direction, images and micro-copy will come from you. Functionality & tech • A clean, responsive build that loads fast on mobile and desktop • Integrated calendar or form for consultation booking, a separate quote request form, plus an email capture tied to Mailchimp (or similar) • Basic on-page SEO best practices so we rank for our own name out of the gate • Easy-to-edit framework—WordPress (Elementor), Webflow or a lightweight React/Vue SPA are all fine as long as I can update text and swap images without touching code. Deliverables for approval 1. Wireframe or low-fidelity mock-up to lock down layout and CTA placement 2. High-fidelity design with copy in place 3. Fully developed, live landing page on my hosting, tested across major browsers and devices 4. Handover package: editable source files, style guide, and a quick Loom walkthrough so I can make simple changes later. Acceptance criteria • All three CTAs function flawlessly and push data to the right destinations • Page passes Google Lighthouse with minimum 90 on Performance and Accessibility • Copy is error-free and aligns with the tone of an expert yet approachable agency. If this scope fits your wheelhouse, I’ll share brand assets and domain credentials so we can kick off right away.

opportunities.title: AI 3D Defect Detection Model
opportunities.description: I need an end-to-end AI solution that takes a reference 3D model (CAD/mesh) and a drone-captured video of the physical object, aligns the two, flags every deviation, and produces a clear, human-readable report. Scope • Input video: a drone will orbit the object and record standard 4K/30 fps footage. • The model must auto-extract frames, reconstruct a usable 3D representation, register it against the reference model, then detect – missing or extra parts – cracks, dents, scratches, or other surface damage – incorrect dimensions, shapes, or part positions. • A PDF/JSON report should list each defect, its coordinates, and severity, plus annotated images for fast visual review. Deliverables – Fully trained model with all weights/checkpoints. – Clean, documented source code (Python preferred; OpenCV, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Open3D welcome). – Inference script or API that accepts a video file and reference model and outputs the defect report. – A short guide showing dataset preparation, training, and deployment steps. Acceptance Criteria 1. Detect ≥90 % of seeded defects on a test set I will provide. 2. False-positive rate ≤5 %. 3. End-to-end processing time under 5 minutes for a 2-minute 4K video on a modern GPU. If you have proven experience in 3D reconstruction, point-cloud registration, or industrial visual inspection, I’m ready to review past work and discuss the data you’ll need to get started.

opportunities.description: Professional 2-Minute Promotional Video for a Mobile Application I am looking for an experienced Video Creator / Motion Graphics Designer / Video Editor to create a high-quality, professional 2-minute promotional advertisement for my mobile application and business. The video will be used for marketing and advertising on YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp and other social media platforms. Video requirements: 1. Duration: Approximately 2 minutes. 2. Style: Ultra-realistic, cinematic, professional commercial advertisement. 3. Characters: Consistent Indian characters with realistic faces and natural expressions throughout the video. 4. Locations: Authentic Indian homes, streets and residential environments. 5. Language: Hindi voice-over and natural Hindi dialogues, with English subtitles. 6. Audio: Professional voice-over, background music and appropriate sound effects. 7. App demonstration: Include actual mobile application screen recordings, registration process, category selection and job notifications. I will provide the required app screenshots and recordings. 8. Branding: App logo, brand colours and final promotional screen will be provided by me. 9. Storytelling: Emotional opening, engaging middle section and powerful promotional ending with a clear call to action. 10. Quality: Professional editing, smooth transitions, colour grading, realistic animations and high-quality sound. Deliverables: - One complete 2-minute master promotional video in 1080p or 4K resolution. - Vertical 9:16 version for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and Facebook Reels. - Horizontal 16:9 version for YouTube and Facebook. - Clean version without subtitles, if technically feasible. - Separate subtitle file (SRT). - Original editable project files and all related assets. - Voice-over and music usage/licensing details.

opportunities.description: Job Title: Apparel Designer Wanted: Full Sublimation Polo Templates for WooCommerce Customiser (SVG Format + Print-Ready Vectors + Commercial Rights) Job Description: We are an apparel reselling business building an online, interactive product configurator on WooCommerce. We are seeking an experienced sportswear graphic designer to create a series of high-quality, full-sublimation polo shirt design templates targeting "Australian Year 6 Leavers" graduation shirts and school sports teams. Intial order would be for 1-2 designs to confirm quality of work. Followed by order of 30-50 designs to allow my school customers plenty of choices We are NOT looking for standard 3D mockups, flat JPEGs, or messy rasterised graphics. We require perfectly structured, web-optimised SVG files for our online customiser, alongside matching production-ready vector master blueprints for manufacturing. opportunities.title: Promote Movie App in WhatsApp
opportunities.description: I’m looking for someone based in India who already manages or owns active, genuine WhatsApp groups—especially local city or community circles—and can introduce my new Movie App to those members. For the trial run I want the link and poster shared in just three to five of your busiest groups. What matters most to me is the number of installs that come directly from your posts, so I will track every click and reward you only for real, verified downloads. No bots, no click-farms, and certainly no recycled screenshots. Here is how we’ll proceed: • You send a short note outlining the kind of groups you control and a line or two about your past experience driving installs. • Once I approve, I’ll provide the app link, poster image, and a custom UTM tag so installs can be traced back to your shares. • After you post, share screenshots plus the install count; payment is released immediately for each verified install. If this pilot goes well, we can scale to more groups and set up a steady weekly target. Let’s get started.

opportunities.title: Historic Dirt Racing Collection
opportunities.description: Long-Term 3D Modelling Opportunity – Racing Vehicles I am looking for a talented and reliable 3D artist to create a large collection of 3D-printable racing vehicles for a tabletop board game. This is intended to be a long-term project, potentially involving well over 100 different vehicle models. Please submit your bid as a price per individual STL car file. We will use your quoted price per STL model to calculate the cost of future work. 1. Vehicle Style and Quality We are looking for low-to-medium quality 3D models suitable for small-scale tabletop board game pieces. The vehicles must look like genuine dirt racing cars, not ordinary street cars. Important: Please carefully examine the reference images below before submitting your bid. These show the type of racing vehicles and appearance we are looking for. Reference images: https://photos.app.goo.gl/FZocVEw7PmY1Ad5G7 https://photos.app.goo.gl/dFPoF3EEYd7nyaBq7 We are not looking for highly detailed, expensive full-scale-quality models. The aim is to produce recognisable, historically accurate racing vehicles that look good when resin printed at a small scale. 2. Scale and Printing Requirements Approximately 1:76–1:72 scale (slightly larger than HO scale for better print detail). Suitable for resin 3D printing. Durable enough for regular tabletop gameplay. Consistent scale across all vehicle classes. Clean, watertight STL files. Models must be ready for resin printing. 3. Vehicle Classes The collection will include vehicles from the following classes: Wing Sprint Cars Non-Wing Sprint Cars Dirt Modifieds Super Modifieds Dirt Late Models Midgets Modified Sedans (Australia) Street Stocks Stock Cars Production Sedans 4 Cylinder Sedans Formula 500s Speedcars Legend Cars Junior Sedans Other significant local dirt racing classes where appropriate. 4. Countries Covered The collection will cover major dirt racing classes from: Australia New Zealand United States United Kingdom 5. Historic Coverage Where possible, we would like to capture approximately four iconic body styles from each decade: 1950s 1960s 1970s 1980s 1990s 2000s 2010s 2020s The aim is to capture the evolution of each racing class over the decades, rather than reproduce individual race cars or specific drivers' liveries. 6. Design Requirements Historically accurate vehicle proportions and body shapes. Models must resemble actual dirt racing cars. Low-to-medium polygon/detail level is acceptable. Clean STL files ready for resin printing. One-piece models preferred wherever possible. Fine details must be strong enough to survive small-scale printing. Rolling wheels are not required. Consistent dimensions and scale across the collection. Avoid unnecessary details that increase modelling time and cost. 7. Pricing and Bidding – Important Please bid on your price per individual STL vehicle model. We are looking for competitive pricing because this project will involve a large number of models. When submitting your proposal, please include: Your price for each individual STL car model. Whether the quoted price includes revisions. Estimated time to complete each model. Whether you can provide a small sample model before starting the larger project. Examples of previous vehicle modelling or 3D printing work. Confirmation that we will receive the STL files with commercial usage rights for our board game. We would prefer to establish an agreed price per STL file that can be used throughout the project. 8. Long-Term Opportunity This is not a one-off modelling job. We are developing a historic dirt racing collection for a tabletop board game, with plans for well over 100 vehicle models covering different classes, countries and decades. We are looking for a 3D artist who is interested in building a long-term working relationship and producing models consistently at an agreed price per vehicle. If you have experience creating small-scale vehicles, racing cars or models for resin 3D printing, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your bid based on the cost of one individual STL car model.

opportunities.title: URGENT: AI Music Video (57 s) + 3 Comedy Skits (25 s) for Caribbean Auto Parts Store | Deliver by Mon Nov 2 | $250 Fixed
opportunities.description: We're hiring a video creator to produce Auto Depot's Black Friday campaign: one 57-second music video and three 25-second comedy skits, made entirely with AI video and AI voices. RUSH JOB: everything goes live Monday, Nov 2. The client is Auto Depot, an auto parts store in Sint Maarten. The videos are for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and WhatsApp Status. WHAT WE PROVIDE - The music: the 57-second soca song "Black Friday, Misbehave" - Real photos and videos of the Auto Depot store locations Everything else is created on your end, from the storyline to the characters. WHAT YOU CREATE 1. Music video, 57 s: your storyline and characters, cut on the beat to the song (it has vocals almost all the way through, so no dialogue). 2. Three comedy skits, 25 s each: your storylines, characters, dialogue and voices. Each skit sells one deal and ends with a few seconds of the song and an end card: - Hankook battery + free jump starter - 50% off body parts - Buy 2 Tires Get 2 Free 3. All AI shots, lip-sync, editing, on-screen text, captions and end cards (logo, deal, location, phone). Use the same characters across all four videos so they feel like one campaign. The store must match our real photos and videos. FINAL DELIVERY MP4, 1080p minimum, vertical 9:16 and square 1:1 for every video; burned-in captions on the skits; full commercial usage rights and the project files. VOICE AND STYLE: AUTHENTIC SINT MAARTEN The characters and voices must feel like real people from Sint Maarten: warm, melodic, unhurried speech with a gentle sing-song rise and fall and softened endings ("ain'", "wha'"), relaxed everyday rhythm with real pauses. NOT Jamaican, Trinidadian, African, American, or an advert voice. Comedy should come from timing and understatement. Each character keeps the same voice in every skit. REFERENCE VOICES (LISTEN ONLY) These public videos show how people in Sint Maarten actually speak (cadence and tonality): 1. Emancipation Day 2026, Government of Sint Maarten, listen from about 3:00 to 12:00: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fSYcBgl8UNw&t=180s 2. Council of Ministers press briefing, Oct 21 2026, around 13:00: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qn23DXSFMEs&t=780s 3. Council of Ministers press briefing, Oct 28 2026, around 8:00: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kUPsZjLHW24&t=480s These are samples for reference only. For legal reasons, do NOT use, clip, copy or clone any audio or any real person's voice from these videos. All voices in the final videos must be original AI voices that match this style. IMPORTANT - No Black Friday banners in any shot; deals appear only as on-screen text and end cards. - Spell it "Tires" on screen, with the small print "Selected tire brands, while stocks last". - Will not be accepted: characters that change between shots, distorted faces or hands, obvious AI artifacts, generic stock footage. REQUIREMENTS - Proven AI video work with consistent characters (Higgsfield, Seedance, Kling, Runway, Veo or similar) - Script writing for short comedy - AI voices with a convincing Caribbean accent, and natural lip-sync - Editing to music on the beat - Available this weekend and quick to respond BUDGET AND DEADLINE - $250 USD fixed for all four videos, including all AI credits - Paid through Freelancer milestones on approval - Short storyline and character outline for approval first, then one round of revisions on the drafts - Final delivery Monday morning, Nov 2; if time runs short, deliver the music video first HOW TO APPLY Start your proposal with "BLACK FRIDAY SOCA". Include: 1. Links to 2-3 AI videos you made, ideally with recurring characters and lip-sync 2. A one-line idea for the music video storyline 3. Confirmation you can deliver all four by Monday morning, Nov 2, within $250 4. A short AI voice sample in a Sint Maarten accent Proposals without the phrase or the voice sample won't be considered.

opportunities.title: Decrypt My WhatsApp Chat Backup
opportunities.description: I have a WhatsApp chat backup file (the usual .crypt format) that I need fully decrypted so I can read the conversations outside the app. Unfortunately, I no longer remember the password and I never saved the 64-digit encryption key. The good news is that I still have complete access to the same WhatsApp account on the same Android phone where the backup was created. What I will supply: • The encrypted backup file stored in Google Drive and, if needed, a local copy from the device. • Temporary access to the phone (USB debugging enabled) so you can extract the decryption key via ADB, root, or any safe method you prefer. What I expect back: • The decoded msgstore database in an easily readable format—SQLite, CSV, or even a simple text export is fine—as long as every chat, timestamp, and attachment path is intact and searchable. • Clear, step-by-step notes of what you did so I can repeat the process if I ever need to. I’m open to any proven technique, whether you rely on tools like WhatsApp Key/DB Extractor, NanoBackup, or a custom script in Python, Java, or Bash. Security and data integrity matter more to me than speed, so please outline how you’ll keep the data local and private during the work. If you have verifiable experience decrypting WhatsApp backups without the original key, I’d love to hear your approach and timeline.

opportunities.title: Social Media Strategy, AI Marketing & Automation Consultant
opportunities.description: Experience: 4–5+ Years Engagement: Freelance / Part-time Consulting, with Potential for Ongoing Work ## About the Project Future Profilez is looking for an experienced Social Media Marketing and AI Automation Consultant to help improve our social media strategy, marketing workflows and B2B lead generation. We have an internal marketing team and need an expert who can recommend the right tools, implement practical AI-powered workflows, establish efficient processes and train our team. This is not a routine social media management role. We are looking for someone who can combine marketing strategy, hands-on implementation, automation and team training. ## Key Responsibilities - Develop social media strategies for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube, covering content planning, organic growth and brand positioning. - Guide Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads strategy, campaign optimisation, retargeting and B2B lead generation. - Evaluate and implement AI-powered workflows for content creation, scheduling, publishing and reporting. - Build marketing automations using tools such as Make, Zapier, n8n, ManyChat and relevant CRM integrations. - Improve lead capture, qualification, follow-ups and performance tracking. - Create SOPs, templates and reporting frameworks, and train our internal marketing team. ## Required Expertise - 4–5+ years of hands-on social media marketing experience. - Strong understanding of organic and paid social media marketing. - Practical experience with AI marketing tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Canva AI or similar platforms. - Experience implementing automation workflows and third-party integrations. - Understanding of B2B lead generation and marketing analytics. - Ability to document processes and train an internal team. Experience working with IT companies, software development agencies or B2B businesses is preferred. Knowledge of AI agents, APIs and custom AI workflows will be an added advantage. ## Expected Deliverables - Social media strategy and improvement roadmap. - AI marketing tool recommendations with pricing and use cases. - Implementation of agreed AI and marketing automation workflows. - Content creation, publishing and reporting processes. - B2B lead generation and follow-up recommendations. - SOPs, documentation and practical team training. ## To Apply Please include the following in your proposal: 1. Your relevant experience and portfolio. 2. Examples of social media campaigns you have managed or strategised. 3. AI marketing and automation tools you have used in actual projects. 4. One or two automation workflows you have personally implemented, explaining what they automate. 5. Your experience with B2B lead generation. 6. Your proposed charges and estimated timeline for the initial engagement. Important: We are looking for someone with demonstrable implementation experience, not someone whose work is limited to content posting, creative design or theoretical tool recommendations.

opportunities.title: Dental Clinic Website Developer Needed (WordPress)
opportunities.description: We are looking for an experienced WordPress developer to develop and customize professional websites for dental clinics. The project involves creating modern, responsive and user-friendly dental clinic websites using existing WordPress themes and templates. Project Responsibilities - Customize existing WordPress themes and templates for dental clinics. - Develop professional 5–7 page dental clinic websites. - Customize website layouts, colors, fonts and design elements. - Add clinic logos, images, content and contact information. - Create essential pages such as Home, About Us, Treatments, Our Doctors, Gallery and Contact. - Configure appointment enquiry forms and WhatsApp integration. - Set up call-to-action buttons and contact details. - Ensure mobile, tablet and desktop responsiveness. - Configure basic on-page SEO settings. - Optimize images and ensure proper website performance. - Test websites and fix any design or functionality issues before delivery. What We Provide We already have the necessary resources and infrastructure: - WordPress themes and templates. - Domain and hosting. - Required plugins and tools. - Website content and images. - Design references and development instructions. The developer will primarily focus on website customization, implementation and delivery. Building everything from scratch is not required. Required Skills - Strong experience with WordPress. - Proficiency in Elementor / Elementor Pro. - Experience customizing WordPress themes. - Good knowledge of HTML and CSS. - Responsive website development. - Experience configuring WordPress plugins. - Basic SEO and website optimization knowledge. Project Details -Website Type: Dental Clinic Websites - Platform: WordPress - Page Count: 5–7 pages per website - Engagement: Freelance / Project-based - Work Arrangement: Remote - Payment: Per website - Opportunity: Multiple projects with potential for long-term collaboration. To Apply Please share the following details: 1. Your WordPress development experience. 2. Your experience with Elementor. 3. Links to 3–5 dental, medical or healthcare websites you have developed (general business websites are also welcome). 4. Your estimated turnaround time for a 5–7 page website. 5. Your expected quotation per website. 6. Your availability for ongoing projects. Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who can deliver visually appealing, professional and functional dental clinic websites efficiently. Experience in dental, healthcare or medical website development will be an advantage. We are interested in working with reliable developers who can deliver consistent quality and build a long-term working relationship. To apply, please share your portfolio, experience and pricing proposal. Contact: Nizam

opportunities.title: Concise Digital Store Brief
opportunities.description: I’m ready to launch a website / app that will sell digital downloads, but first I need a razor-sharp project brief that keeps the entire build team aligned without drowning them in fluff. Here’s what I’m looking for: • A clear one-pager (or similarly tight format) that states the purpose of the site—an e-commerce platform focused exclusively on digital products. • Key user journeys that show how a visitor discovers, purchases, and receives a download. • A succinct feature list covering catalogue management, secure payment, instant delivery, licence handling, and basic analytics—no more, no less. • Any must-have tech considerations or integration notes (payment gateway, fulfilment automation, DRM, etc.) phrased so developers and designers can act on them quickly. • Measurable success criteria I can hand straight to stakeholders. Keep language plain, keep it actionable, and trim anything that doesn’t serve the goal of “sell digital goods online.” If you have a favourite framework—Lean Canvas, PRD lite, Notion templates—I’m open to it as long as the end result stays concise. Once delivered, I’ll review and confirm it hits the mark; if a tweak is needed, we’ll iterate once to lock it down.

opportunities.title: Build AI Real Estate Lead Recovery Engine
opportunities.description: We are looking for an experienced AI Automation Specialist to build Lead Recovery Engine, an AI-powered lead reactivation system designed for US real estate investors, wholesalers, and house flippers. The problem we solve: Real estate businesses often have hundreds or thousands of property-owner leads stored in their CRMs. Many of these leads become inactive because sales teams cannot consistently follow up with every contact. This means potentially valuable opportunities are forgotten or lost. What we need: We want to build a system that automatically re-engages these old or inactive leads through SMS and/or email, starts natural conversations, identifies potential sellers, qualifies their interest, and books appointments with the client's sales team. The system should include: - CRM integration (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, or similar). - Automated lead reactivation campaigns. - AI-powered two-way conversations through SMS and email. - Natural conversation flows that identify seller intent and motivation. - Lead qualification based on property details, selling timeline, and motivation. - Automated appointment scheduling and calendar integration. - Automatic CRM updates based on lead responses. - Human handoff when a qualified lead is ready or requires personal attention. - Follow-up logic, error handling, and monitoring. Preferred technologies: n8n, Make, OpenAI, CRM platforms, Twilio or similar SMS providers, email automation tools, APIs, and webhooks. We are open to your technical recommendations if you can explain why your proposed architecture is reliable, scalable, and cost-effective. Expected outcome: A fully functional and tested first version of Lead Recovery Engine that we can demonstrate to potential clients and adapt to different real estate businesses. We also need complete documentation, access to all workflows and configurations, and a clear handover so our company retains control of the system. Important: We are not looking for a basic chatbot or a simple automation connecting two applications. We need a complete lead recovery solution with intelligent conversations, qualification, CRM integration, and appointment booking. We are interested in building a long-term relationship with the right specialist as we grow and deploy this system for multiple clients.

Necesitamos profesionales capaces de generar confianza, resolver objeciones y cerrar contrataciones de manera efectiva. Ofrecemos un salario fijo más comisiones por ventas propias, y comisiones adicionales por las ventas del equipo. El trabajo es a distancia, en horario comercial de España, y proporcionamos CRM, guiones y material de apoyo. Se busca una colaboración estable con posibilidades de crecimiento profesional. opportunities.title: Desarrollo de Aplicación Web Multiempresa para Gestión de Remunerac...
opportunities.description: Se busca un equipo o desarrollador para crear una aplicación web robusta y segura destinada a una firma jurídica especializada en asesoría de remuneración flexible para empleados. La plataforma debe ser multiempresa, permitiendo el ingreso con roles diferenciados y asegurando el aislamiento de datos entre cada firma. Los módulos clave incluyen: - Ingreso multiempresa con gestión de roles y datos aislados. - Carga masiva de datos de empleados y remuneración desde archivos Excel/CSV, con validaciones integradas para asegurar la integridad de la información. - Configuración de parámetros por empresa, incluyendo proporción de remuneración, menú de beneficios, elegibilidad y reglas vigentes. - Un simulador individual que compare el esquema de remuneración actual con el propuesto, asigne cupos de beneficios y muestre detalles como salario, aportes, retención, ingreso neto, efectivo disponible, beneficios restringidos y ahorros mensuales/anuales. - Generación de reportes individuales en formato PDF/Excel y reportes consolidados. - Un sistema de auditoría completo para registrar cargas, modificaciones, simulaciones y aprobaciones. La firma proporcionará presentaciones y capturas de un simulador anterior como referencia funcional. Es fundamental que las reglas jurídicas y fórmulas, definidas por la firma, sean configurables, versionables y diferenciadas para salario ordinario e integral. Se prefiere el uso de tecnologías como React/TypeScript para el frontend, ASP.NET Core (.net 10 lts) para el backend y postgresql como base de datos, aunque se considerarán alternativas bien justificadas. Dada la naturaleza de los datos (personales y salariales), la seguridad es primordial, requiriendo aislamiento por empresa, permisos por rol, cifrado de datos, auditoría exhaustiva y respaldos regulares. El alojamiento de la aplicación debe ofrecer una tarifa mensual fija, sin cobros automáticos basados en el número de usuarios, simulaciones o consultas, ni autoescalado. Se deberá especificar la capacidad, límites, costo de respaldos y posibles cargos adicionales. La propiedad del código fuente, el acceso al repositorio, las cuentas de despliegue y toda la documentación técnica deben ser transferidos a la firma al finalizar el proyecto. Se solicita incluir en la propuesta la experiencia en el desarrollo de aplicaciones multiempresa, un cronograma detallado y una cotización separada por fases de desarrollo, costos de alojamiento y mantenimiento. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Crear un nuevo sitio personalizado

opportunities.title: Videos Financieros Narrativos YouTube
opportunities.description: Necesito producir una serie de videos que capten la atención desde los primeros segundos y mantengan una alta retención para así poder monetizar mi canal. La temática es enseñar economía y finanzas personales a adultos que desean mejorar su situación, pero todo debe ir contado en forma de historias: anécdotas cotidianas, casos reales y ejemplos que emocionen antes de explicar el concepto económico de fondo. Cada pieza debe sentirse profesional y dinámica, con ritmo audiovisual atractivo, subtítulos claros y llamadas a la acción discretas que motiven al espectador a ver otro episodio, suscribirse y compartir. Valoraría el uso de motion graphics sencillos, efectos de sonido ligeros y música de fondo libre de derechos que no opaque la narración. Entrego las ideas centrales de cada historia y espero a cambio: • Guion pulido con apertura “hook”, desarrollo narrativo y cierre recordable • Edición completa en formato 16:9 listo para subir a YouTube en 1080p • Miniatura atractiva y título sugerido optimizado para SEO Acepto propuestas de duración (entre 15 - 20 min si el ritmo lo permite) y sugerencias de estilo siempre que el objetivo de monetización (CTR alto y watch time prolongado) se mantenga en el centro. Estoy disponible para resolver dudas y revisar versiones intermedias hasta alcanzar el resultado óptimo.

opportunities.title: Gana bien haciendo el bien
opportunities.description: Digpatho (Programa Comercial 2026 – Latino América) es una iniciativa innovadora de Digpatho SAS enfocada en expandir el acceso a la tecnología médica de vanguardia en Latinoamérica. El proyecto tiene como objetivo vincular a médicos y veterinarios con herramientas de diagnóstico avanzadas, impulsadas por inteligencia artificial (IA) y geometría fractal, facilitando de este modo el diagnóstico preciso y el control de inventarios en el sector de la salud. La propuesta comercial está diseñada para personas en Latinoamérica con vocación de relacionamiento y seguimiento, sin que sea un requisito contar con experiencia previa como visitadores médicos. Los colaboradores, que pueden complementar esta labor con sus actividades actuales, se encargan de cerrar ventas mientras que un sistema automatizado de bots asume la mayor parte del trabajo operativo (como la identificación de prospectos). Beneficios y Aspectos Clave de la Oportunidad: • Ingresos Proyectados: Estimación de un ingreso mínimo mensual recurrente de 1500 a 2000 dólares durante el primer año (con base en el cumplimiento de las reglas del reglamento comercial). Dedicación a tiempo parcial. • Seguridad y Transparencia: Todo el esquema de comisiones y el cálculo de pagos se definen formalmente y por escrito mediante un reglamento firmado. El registro de oportunidades se realiza en una plataforma CRM para proteger la cartera de cada colaborador. • Perspectiva de Crecimiento Global: Aunque la convocatoria actual se concentra en el mercado latinoamericano, el proyecto abarca oportunidades de venta en todo el territorio hispanohablante y global. • Incentivo Societario: Dependiendo del desempeño demostrado, existe la posibilidad de acceder a acciones de la compañía, actualmente valorada en 10 millones de dólares y con una proyección de crecimiento exponencial en el corto plazo. En resumen, Digpatho propone un modelo de negocio con propósito, combinando impacto social y un sólido esquema de compensación apoyado en tecnología.

opportunities.title: Diseño Marketplace para Productos de Descanso
opportunities.description: Diseñador Gráfico Freelance para Marketplace (Mercado Libre / Amazon) – 12 imágenes por producto Somos una empresa mexicana con más de 60 años de experiencia en la comercialización de colchones, almohadas y productos para el descanso. Buscamos un diseñador gráfico freelance especializado en e-commerce y marketplaces para colaborar en la creación de contenido visual de nuestros productos. Objetivo del proyecto: Diseñar 12 imágenes profesionales por producto para publicaciones en Mercado Libre, Amazon y otros marketplaces, con un enfoque comercial, creativo y orientado a aumentar las conversiones y las ventas. Requisitos clave: - Lifestyle scenes: Crear escenas realistas y aspiracionales de dormitorios con iluminación natural, decoración elegante y el producto como enfoque principal. - Infografías: Diseñar imágenes informativas con titulares cortos, iconos claros, dimensiones precisas y texto fácil de leer en dispositivos móviles. Todo el copy debe estar en español mexicano. - Fidelidad al producto: Preservar los tejidos originales, acolchado, colores, proporciones, etiquetas y logotipos exactamente como fueron proporcionados. La inteligencia artificial solo se utilizará para ambientaciones sin rediseñar el producto. - Imagen principal: Presentar el producto sobre un fondo blanco puro sin textos promocionales añadidos. - Consistencia: Seguir la identidad visual de cada marca y garantizar que cada imagen tenga un propósito único. Evitar usar una sola plantilla para todas las imágenes. - Precisión: Usar solo especificaciones técnicas confirmadas (capas internas, certificaciones o reclamos deben ser reales). Entregables por lote: - Imágenes .jpg 1200 × 1200 px finales (12 imágenes). - Archivos editables con capas. Proceso de aprobación: Se requiere aprobar primero la imagen principal junto a una infografía clave antes del resto del lote final. Para postularte: Compártenos tu portafolio relevante (incluyendo mercados locales como Mercado Libre/Amazon). Cuéntanos cuánto tiempo aproximas por lote completo tras las revisiones iniciales aprobadas. Preferencia alta por profesionales con especialización comprobada trabajando en categorías hogar/descanso.

opportunities.title: Construcción Tienda Online Moda
opportunities.description: Quiero lanzar una tienda online para vender ropa de mujer de estilo casual y cómoda para el día a día. Necesito a alguien que se encargue de todo el proceso de creación de la tienda, desde la elección y configuración de la plataforma (Shopify, WooCommerce o similar) hasta que el sitio esté listo para recibir pedidos. Alcance esperado • Diseño de una identidad visual coherente con la propuesta “casual-confort”. • Maquetación responsive con una navegación sencilla y fotografías atractivas. • Carga inicial de productos (yo proporcionaré las imágenes y descripciones básicas). • Configuración de pasarelas de pago seguras y métodos de envío estándar. • Integración con redes sociales para facilitar la difusión de lanzamientos y promociones. • Ajustes básicos de SEO on-page y conexión con Google Analytics para seguimiento. Entregables 1. Sitio web funcional publicado en mi dominio. 2. Manual breve (o video) donde pueda ver cómo añadir nuevos productos y gestionar pedidos. 3. Una revisión posterior al lanzamiento para afinar detalles de usabilidad o contenido. Busco a un profesional que tenga experiencia previa montando e-commerce de moda y sepa equilibrar buen diseño con rapidez de carga. Si dominas herramientas de optimización de imágenes, plugins de marketing y prácticas de usabilidad, menciónalo en tu propuesta.

opportunities.title: Contenido TikTok Rehabilitación LCA Hogar
opportunities.description: Quiero convertir la guía de rehabilitación de ligamento cruzado anterior en piezas breves, claras y motivadoras que funcionen en TikTok. El público son personas de cualquier edad con cirugía reciente, así que el lenguaje debe ser sencillo y sin tecnicismos. Alcance del trabajo • Desarrollar un calendario de publicaciones con guiones de 1-2 minutos y textos de apoyo pensados para TikTok (formato vertical, ritmo ágil y dinámico). • Dividir la información en tres grandes etapas: primeras semanas, meses 2-3 y meses 4-6. • Mostrar ejercicios seguros explicados paso a paso como eje principal: calentamiento, rango de movimiento, fortalecimiento y propiocepción, siempre sin equipamiento especial. • Incluir señales de alerta para saber cuándo parar y consultar al médico. • Añadir consejos prácticos de vida diaria (dormir, subir escaleras, uso de calzado, transporte, etc.). • Cerrar cada pieza con recordatorio de que la información es educativa y no sustituye la opinión profesional. Entregables 1. 15 guiones de video (Word o Google Docs) con indicaciones de plano, texto en pantalla y voz en off. 2. 15 textos cortos acompañantes (150 - 200 caracteres) listos para publicarse como descripción y hashtags sugeridos. 3. Un esquema visual por fase que resuma los ejercicios mostrados, útil para futuras infografías. 4. Documento de referencias científicas básicas que respalde la información. Tono y estilo Amable, alentador y empático. Uso de frases breves, emojis moderados y llamadas a la acción que inviten a seguir la serie completa de videos. Para evaluar tu propuesta, comparte ejemplos de trabajos similares: guiones, reels o hilos sobre salud, deporte o temas médicos explicados de forma accesible. Estoy disponible para resolver dudas y ajustar detalles antes de comenzar.

proposal.subject: Suministro Directo de Café Especial Borbón Rosado (Tostado, Molido a Medida y Lotes) — Origen San Agustín, Huila
proposal.body:
¡Hola Solicitante Anuncio #40794760 (Tareas en Español)! 👋 Un cordial saludo desde San Agustín, Huila.

Somos un emprendimiento productor y comercializador de **Café Especial de Origen San Agustín / Sur del Huila** con perfilación sensorial avalada por **Catador Q-Grader (+85 a 89 puntos SCA)** y nos comunicamos respecto a **Lanzamiento Amazon US: Visibilidad y Ventas**:

☕ **1. Café Borbón Rosado Tostado y Molido a Medida**: Entregamos en grano entero o con el **nivel exacto de molienda** (fina espresso, media V60/Chemex/filtro, gruesa prensa francesa) y **curva de tostión** (clara, media o media-oscura) que requiera su empresa o cliente (presentaciones de 250g, 500g y bolsas institucionales por kilos con válvula desgasificadora).
📦 **2. Lotes Más Grandes y Microlotes**: Disponibilidad de lotes mayores en pergamino seco seleccionado (humedad 10%-11.5%), café verde tipo exportación o tostado por volumen con trazabilidad directa de vereda en San Agustín (Alto del Obispo, La Estrella, El Tablón, Los Cauchos).
🏅 **3. Calidad Garantizada**: Perfil dulce, limpio, notas a panela, melocotón y flor de café, libre de defectos primarios.

📲 Nuestro WhatsApp directo es **+57 322 273 9034**. ¿A qué dirección o laboratorio les enviamos muestra física y ficha técnica de nuestro Borbón Rosado?

opportunities.title: Comercial B2B Freelance para Automatización Industrial
opportunities.description: TOMEC busca comercial freelance B2B para el sector industrial | Retribución por resultados En TOMEC, empresa de ingeniería especializada en automatización industrial y logística, buscamos incorporar un colaborador comercial freelance para desarrollar nuestra cartera de clientes. Trabajamos en proyectos de automatización, programación PLC, robótica, sistemas de transporte y clasificación, soluciones AMR/ACR y optimización de procesos logísticos, con experiencia en proyectos para grandes empresas como Amazon y otros clientes industriales. ¿Cuál será tu misión? - Identificar empresas industriales con necesidades de automatización. - Contactar con gerentes y responsables de ingeniería, operaciones, mantenimiento y logística. - Generar oportunidades comerciales y concertar reuniones. - Realizar el seguimiento de las oportunidades hasta el cierre de las operaciones, con apoyo técnico de nuestro equipo. ¿Qué buscamos? - Experiencia demostrable en ventas B2B. - Capacidad para captar clientes y abrir nuevas cuentas. - Se valorará especialmente la experiencia comercial en automatización industrial, ingeniería, robótica, intralogística o servicios técnicos. - Autonomía, iniciativa y orientación a resultados. ¿Qué ofrecemos? - Colaboración freelance, sin exclusividad inicial. - Modelo de remuneración basado en resultados, con comisiones vinculadas a las operaciones comerciales. - Apoyo técnico y comercial de TOMEC. - Posibilidad de desarrollar una colaboración estable y ampliar progresivamente el volumen de negocio. Buscamos una persona que sepa abrir puertas en el sector industrial y convertir oportunidades en negocio. Si tienes experiencia comercial B2B y te interesa colaborar con TOMEC, envíanos tu perfil y una breve descripción de tu experiencia, los sectores en los que trabajas y los resultados comerciales que has conseguido.

opportunities.title: Offline ETT Workflow Automation Desktop App
opportunities.description: PROJECT: COMPLETE OFFLINE DESKTOP APPLICATION FOR ETT ADMINISTRATIVE AUTOMATION Maximum fixed budget: €300. We are a Spanish temporary employment agency (ETT) looking for a developer to build a complete desktop application to automate our administrative workflow for employees assigned to companies in France. We are not looking for a demo, prototype or basic example. We want the complete application described below, with all the requested processes integrated into one working system. The maximum budget available for this project is €300. Please only submit a proposal if you are willing to work within this budget. 1. EXISTING SOFTWARE AND ACCESS We can provide access to our existing systems: - NominaSOL: We already use this software and can provide access so you can inspect how it works, particularly its Social Security functionality and certificate-based operations. - Amin: This website belongs to our company. We also have a copy of the website available for technical inspection. - We can provide document templates and examples of our current administrative paperwork. We want you to investigate these systems and use available integration methods wherever technically possible. 2. DESKTOP APPLICATION We require an offline-first desktop program installed on our computer or authorised local infrastructure. Requirements: - Desktop graphical interface. - Local database and document storage. - No Google Drive dependency. - Employee management and individual files. - Automated workflow management. - PDF generation and document merging. - Secure handling of employee information. - Complete source code and installation instructions. Local employee management and document processing must work without cloud storage. Internet access will be required for external online operations. 3. EMPLOYEE DOCUMENT PROCESSING AND OCR Our commercial department receives NIE/passport documents and employment information through WhatsApp. The application must allow document uploads and use OCR to extract: - First name and surname. - NIE / identification number. - Expiry date. - Date of birth. - Nationality. - Address, postcode, city and province. - Country and place of birth. - Passport information, where available. Employment start date, French client company and contract duration must also be recorded. Extracted information must be reviewable and editable. 4. EMPLOYEE DATABASE The application must create and maintain individual employee records. It must detect duplicates, reuse existing employees and preserve previous employment assignments and historical documentation without overwriting earlier files. 5. SOCIAL SECURITY AND NAF The application must support NAF consultation using employee identification details and automate the relevant process through the available authorised Social Security integration. It must also process employee registrations through Sistema RED, using the relevant employee information, NAF, start date, Social Security regime and employer CCC. The system must record official responses and clearly distinguish confirmed registrations, rejected operations, pending operations and errors. We can provide NominaSOL access so you can investigate how its existing Social Security connection works. 6. AMIN AND CONTRACT DOCUMENTS The application must connect with our Amin environment where technically possible. It must search for existing employees, reuse their records or create new ones, and generate: - Employment contracts. - Mission contracts (contrat de mission). - CPD documentation, where applicable. Generated documents must be saved as PDFs in the corresponding employee file. You can inspect our Amin website and the copy we own to determine the best integration method. 7. FRANCE POSTING AND A1 The application must manage the information required for employees posted to France, including employee details, Spanish employer information, applicable Social Security regime and CCC, French client company, workplace address and assignment dates. We want the A1 application process automated through the available authorised channels. If online submission fails, the system must save the error or submission receipt and support the alternative manual procedure, including TA300 documentation where applicable. The application must distinguish between an A1 application prepared, submitted, pending, rejected and an officially issued A1 certificate. 8. SIPSI AND FINAL DOCUMENTATION SIPSI information and documentation must be organised within the employee file. The declaration itself may be completed manually if no authorised integration is available. The application must generate and organise the final documentation package, allow PDFs to be merged and prepare the employee file for delivery to the French client. 9. USER INTERFACE We require a clear interface with: - Employee search and database. - Individual employee files. - New employment assignment. - Document upload and OCR. - Social Security and NAF status. - Amin document status. - A1 status. - SIPSI status. - PDF generation and merging. - Error and pending-operation notifications. 10. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS We are open to your recommended technology. Python/PySide6, SQLite, Tesseract OCR and PDF libraries are possible options. The application must include local storage, basic logging, error handling and backup functionality. All credentials and digital certificates must be handled securely. We will not provide unrestricted access to real certificates or passwords. 11. DELIVERABLES The project must include: - Complete working desktop application. - All requested workflow modules. - Source code. - Installation instructions. - Database structure. - Basic user documentation. - Rights to use and modify the delivered application. Any external integration must be genuinely implemented and tested. Do not describe an operation as automated if it still requires manual execution. 12. FREELANCER PROPOSAL Please explain how you would implement the complete project within our maximum budget of €300. Tell us about your experience with desktop applications, OCR, PDF automation, databases, browser automation and integrations with business software. We can provide access to NominaSOL, our Amin environment and sample documents to help you understand the existing workflow. We are looking for a developer capable of delivering the complete application, not just a visual prototype.

opportunities.title: Edición Dinámica para Videos Gaming
opportunities.description: Tengo un pequeño canal de videojuegos en YouTube y quiero llevar la edición de mis videos a un nivel mucho más profesional. Busco a alguien que domine un estilo dinámico con cortes rápidos, efectos y toques de humor que mantengan la energía alta de principio a fin. ¿Qué necesito? • Edición más profesional para mis videos, centrada en un ritmo ágil y entretenido. • Inclusión regular de: – Subtítulos animados que resalten mis frases y reacciones. – Efectos de sonido, zooms y transiciones rápidas para enfatizar momentos clave. – Memes, imágenes y clips de apoyo que conecten con la cultura gamer y añadan chispa. Cómo trabajaremos – Te entregaré el gameplay bruto junto con las indicaciones de los momentos importantes y cualquier referencia de estilo. – Espero un primer borrador breve para alinear tono y ritmo; después realizarías los ajustes finales. – El archivo final debe estar optimizado para YouTube (1080p , códec H.264, buen balance de audio). Si disfrutas transformando gameplays en contenido vibrante y lleno de memes, anímate a colaborar conmigo. ¡Hagamos que cada video atrape desde el primer segundo!
